title: Update 15.3 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 15.3 for Business Central 2019 Release Wave 2 introduces hotfixes, feature changes including reference document display on sales documents, MICR fonts, printer extension events, report bookmarking, and sign-in telemetry. Use this page to understand what changed in this update and upgrade paths.
